minutes_text:
CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 24, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD,
  4TH FLOOR, QUEEN MARY CONFERENCE ROOM, 8:30 AM

Erik Frost Hollins, President  Joen Garnica, Commissioner
Robyn Gordon-Peterson, Vice President  Victoria Love, Commissioner
  Jose Osuna, Commissioner

Christina Pizarro Winting, Executive Director

  SPECIAL MEETING

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 8:45 AM, President Frost Hollins called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Hollins, Garnica, Osuna, Gordon-Peterson, Love

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 Brandon Nottingham, Business Representative with IAMAW District 947, led the pledge of
 allegiance.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 A memo from Mayor Richardson and Tom Modica regarding the charter initiative was submitted as
 public comment.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-51889  Discussion of recommended action in response to proposed ballot initiative.

  A motion was made by Vice President Gordon-Peterson, seconded by
  Commissioner Osuna, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Hollins, Garnica, Osuna, Gordon-Peterson, Love
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  A motion was made by President Hollins, seconded by Commissioner Osuna,

  Page 1 of 3
   CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 24, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD,
  4TH FLOOR, QUEEN MARY CONFERENCE ROOM, 8:30 AM

  to express disappointment in the lack of consultation with the Commission
  and Department prior to sending this proposal out to all City employees and
  an acceptance of the invitation to conversation with the Mayor and City
  Manager in open session. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Hollins, Garnica, Osuna, Gordon-Peterson, Love
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  A motion was made by President Hollins, seconded by Commissioner Love,
  to encourage the City Manager to take a more respectful tone towards the
  Department in future communications with employees. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Hollins, Garnica, Osuna, Gordon-Peterson, Love
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Christina Pizarro Winting, Executive Director, provided a statement on behalf of the
  Civil Service Commission and department about the charter initiative.

  Erik Frost Hollins, President of the Civil Service Commission, shared a statement
  about the charter initiative.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Caprice McDonald addressed the Commission regarding the charter initiative.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

There were no announcements.

ADJOURNMENT

At 9:34 AM, there being no objection, President Frost Hollins declared the meeting adjourned.
